svg.title: WharfSWE p90 agent duration by Copilot CLI revision
svg.desc: Selected WharfSWE models, with one point per completed 56-trial arm. X is the revision of CLI 1.0.x; Y shows p90 agent time (m:ss). The X axis starts at revision 95. Y axis: 0:00 to 11:00. Lines join observed runs only.
